stories.title: Clippers docked five first-round picks, fined $30M
stories.summary: As a result of the investigation into the team's signing of Kawhi Leonard, the NBA docked the Clippers 5 1st-round picks, fined them $30M and suspended owner Steve Ballmer for 1 year. The Clippers plan to challenge the findings "through every avenue."

stories.title: Tiger's license suspended 5 years after plea deal
stories.summary: Tiger Woods had his driver's license suspended five years Wednesday after striking a plea deal in his DUI case.

stories.title: Georgia AG to SEC: Oust LSU if Kiffin plays pros
stories.summary: Georgia Attorney General Chris Carr is encouraging Greg Sankey to take "all measures available," including suspending and/or removing LSU from the SEC if the Tigers roster former NFL players.

stories.title: Carr, Manning top packed Heisman odds boards
stories.summary: Notre Dame quarterback CJ Carr and Texas quarterback Arch Manning are the favorites to win the Heisman Trophy, but the odds at sportsbooks suggest it's a wide-open race.

stories.title: Reports: Man charged in Barkley break-in case
stories.summary: A 24-year-old man has been arrested and charged with multiple felonies in collection with an attempted break-in at the home of Eagles running back Saquon Barkley and two other burglaries.
